verdict.rationale: Grafana ships as open-source software (Grafana OSS, public GitHub repo, a FOSS AGPL license), and community users describe setting it up and running it on their own machines. Companion components such as Loki and Mimir are documented to run locally in single-binary mode. Missing for 10: first-party installation/deployment docs for the Grafana server itself in the pack, and explicit evidence on which features (Enterprise/Cloud-only AI features) are unavailable when self-hosted.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
